imgopt.title: Compress old images
imgopt.lead: Pictures uploaded before automatic compression: turned into light, sharp WebP with the same rules as a new upload — a smaller database and backups, and faster pages.
imgopt.run_sub: Runs in the background, one picture after another — you can leave this page and come back.
imgopt.finished: Finished: {done} compressed, {kept} kept as they were (already small), {size} saved.
imgopt.confirm: {n} pictures will be replaced with a compressed WebP (up to 2048 px on the long side). This cannot be undone. Continue?
imgopt.rules: Never touched: browser icons, signatures and stamps (used in PDFs), PDFs, fonts and other files. A picture that does not get smaller stays as it is and is not tried again.
imgopt.nothing: Nothing to compress, or a run is already in progress.
imgopt.stopping: Compression stops after the current picture.
